Linux gaming is on fire - (We love you Feral)

Not to mention that Open Source Mesa drivers are very important for the native implementation of DirectX in Linux to allow easier porting of Linux games. It would be interesting to see games that only work with FLOSS drivers that force Nvidia and AMD to work with Mesa instead of doing their own thing. http://www.phoronix.com/scan.php?page=article&item=mesa_gallium3d_d3d11&num=1

I don't see DirectX ports being a problem as long as it's natively implemented without OpenGL conversion overhead, which is what ruins many ports when they come to Linux. If a port uses Gallium, they can then focus more on the rest of the game instead of worrying about features using in DX9-11 (most used DX versions, not a DX conspiracy :P) that don't convert directly to efficient OpenGL code. It's good to have more than one graphics API available on Linux anyway :)
